title: Fix backend initialization bug preventing Nakshatra data availability

requirements.text: Modify backend/main.mo to check if Nakshatra storage is empty on initialization and automatically trigger migration seeding if no data exists

quotes: please initialize the backend. No data available. fix this bug

acceptanceCriteria: Backend automatically detects empty Nakshatra storage on first deployment or upgrade
Migration seeding runs automatically when storage is empty
All 27 Nakshatras are populated with complete data from migration.mo
Admin dashboard displays all Nakshatra entries without 'No Data Available' error

requirements.text: Add initialization logging to backend/main.mo to track when migration seeding occurs and report success or failure
acceptanceCriteria: Backend logs initialization events including storage state checks
Migration execution is logged with count of seeded Nakshatras
Any initialization failures are logged with clear error messages

requirements.text: Ensure migration.mo seeding logic is invoked during backend initialization when storage is empty, populating all 27 Nakshatras with their complete astronomical and mythological data
acceptanceCriteria: Migration seeding runs automatically on empty storage
All 27 Nakshatras are created with name, description, deity, symbol, ruling planet, pada information, lunarClimate, and karmicLesson fields
Frontend can successfully fetch and display all Nakshatra data after initialization

constraints: Use existing migration.mo data structures and seeding logic
Do not modify frontend files in immutablePaths list
nonGoals: Adding new Nakshatra data fields beyond what exists in migration.mo
Changing frontend UI components or styling
